Hello Anso13,

Please try to clean the "Brick-Force-Cache-folder". You will find this folder at your Brick-Force-folder: Brick-Force/Brick-Force_Data/Resources/Chache.

This Cache saves map data (so called regmap-files) from every map you played in order to allow a faster load of the map while you play the game. Without all these regmap-files Brick-Force should launch without problems. (These regmap-files are not responsible for play the game or loading any map.)

If this don´t work, please be so kind and contact our support at: support.infernum.com

Kind regards
Kalchas

Originally Posted by Deltafight
All accounts the the U.S. server got deleted when we moved to steam I guess so I can't get it back, good thing I didn't put any money in the game.
This is not correct. All U.S. accounts have been migrated to Steam. Every U.S. player, who has been active in the 3 months before the Steam migration received a Steam key to activate his account on Steam, either via mail or via support if the mail didn´t arrive.

The U.S. servers were shut down much later, in February 2015. Before the shut down there were news on the website and Steam and newsletters informing everyone about what will happen. We offered map transfers before the servers closed, we offered the transfer of 3 favourite weapons, Beta items and rare items and we offered the transfer of purchased Tokens and website & Steam packs.

Hundreds of players contacted us and took us up on our offer. Sadly a lot of players didn´t care enough about their account, maps and items and never got in touch until it was too late. When the servers were moved in summer 2015, 5 months after the server closure, we lost access to ingame content and had to stop the item transfers as we couldn´t verify the players had them.

And a year after the closure we also started to refuse the token transfer, as there has been more than enough time to get in touch. The transfer was a goodwill offer to make the transition to the EU servers easier for the players, who have lost everything. Players, who only notice their account is gone 12 months after they received a newsletter about it, don´t intend to play on EU anyway.

Just want to add that despite all US accounts being moved to Steam, you can still access EU server via the downloadable client as long as you don't use a key to activate your account on BF-EU steam version. I feel this is important since a lot of the items for sale on the webpage are not available on steam.(At least last time I checked).

posts.t: Do i need DirectX 9 Or i can use DirectX 11?

posts.h:
Hello, SQUAiR.

Your ping will be determined depends on the locations you're playing at the country you're currently at as well as the network stability. If your network becomes extremely unstable, your ping will exceed +0.300 and may lead Disconnection and forcing you to leave the in-game match to the lobby due to the unstable network.

DirectX however is usually depends on which game you're currently playing on and what may be compatible with. There are some games that can have high FPS boost on most games and FPS drops in most games. But of course, DirectX 9 and DirectX 11 has their own game that can be compatible to boost FPS on games they are compatible with. But if you wish to know the system requirement of Brick-Force, visit here:
http://www.brick-force.com/en/game/download

There will be a minimum system requirement for Brick-Force performance as you scroll down.

However, if you're still having technical issues about Performance during the game, you may send a ticket to the Customer Support Center regarding about Performance Issues here:
https://support.infernum.com/

With best regards,
Kagome.
